note: Identity-only capture for the Small Diameter Bomb, the 250 lb guided bomb family. The entry names the family and no variant: it holds no figure, carries no alias and claims no member. The identity evidence is the engine class table: the installed content displays 'GBU-53 SDB II 250lb' and 'GBU-53/B Stormbreaker' on classes whose own text carries the SDB designation. The grade is claimed, because the evidence is identity text and not a held figure. No document citation is invented. The keyword holds the family designation the display name carries. The GBU-39 and the GBU-53 entries each publish it as a designation, so the family owns it here and a mark entry must not claim it.
